fields.System.Title: OUT-402 — Sequence pick tasks by location
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a picker, I want my list ordered by where things are, so that I walk the aisle once
instead of doubling back.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a pick task with several lines, then they are ordered by the location
  • pick_sequence, not by order line or by product.
  • - Given locations in different zones, then lines are grouped by zone before sequencing
  • within it.
  • - Given the sequence, then it is fixed at task creation so the route does not change
  • under the picker mid-walk.
  • - Given a realistic warehouse layout in the seed data, then a test asserts the resulting
  • route does not revisit an aisle.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, masterdata |
| Tables | pick_task_line, location |
| Risks | Wrong sequence costs hours of walking daily and is invisible in unit tests ([doc 03 §4](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration (against a realistic layout) |
